description: This file defines a Twig token parser class for parsing variable type declarations within Twig templates using a custom 'types' tag.

classes.name: TypesTokenParser
classes.description: A final class extending AbstractTokenParser, responsible for parsing custom 'types' tags in Twig templates to declare variable types.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the 'types' tag in Twig template and returns a TypesNode representing the declared types.

methods.name: parseSimpleMappingExpression
methods.description: Parses a simple mapping expression of variable types within the Twig 'types' tag; returns an associative array of variable names to type info.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns the tag name this parser handles, which is 'types'.
